key_highlights: ASX dipped as oil surged on Middle East/Iran tensions, adding $330B to global energy import bill
Property sector under severe stress: Bathla warns of imminent collapse, investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes, home values decline sharply in August
Aussie interest rate expectations rocket, with fixed mortgage rates edging higher into weekend
Gold and rare earths exploration hit highs: Great Southern WA gold, Barkly NT 99% magnet extraction, Lindian Kazakh rare earths feed secured
Iron ore price weakness ('iron ore roaches seeth') pressures BHP/RIO/FMG
Macquarie $700m audit bid raises governance questions; Star bleeds $307m amid auditor survival doubts
Labor's vote collapses in vital by-election, adding political uncertainty
Consumer trends: GLP-1 weight-loss drug demand surges, EV uptake accelerates, 'dupe' brands gain traction

sectors.trend: Mixed: gold and rare earths exploration at highs (Great Southern, Barkly NT, Lindian, Kaiser, Infini uranium), but iron ore price weakness pressures major miners. Phosphate revival (Aguia) adds diversification.
sectors.implications: Gold juniors and rare earths names (LRE.AX, GSG.AX, WES.AX) attract rotation flows. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from soft iron ore. Uranium (INL.AX) benefits from Canadian drill push.

sectors.trend: Rising rate expectations support NIM but property credit stress (Bathla collapse, investor credit crash) raises NPL concerns. Macquarie audit bid signals M&A activity. Star's $307m loss flags corporate governance risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates but face property exposure. MQG.AX audit bid is a positive catalyst. Monitor ASX-listed property developers for contagion.

sectors.trend: Oil spikes on Iran/Middle East tensions and Hormuz control questions. Oil giant retreats from clean energy. Solar crosses economic tipping point. Gas reservation policy under political attack.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. Solar/RE names (SOL.AX, ALE.AX) gain from tipping point narrative. LNG exporters (GAS.AX, QAN.AX) face policy headwinds.

sectors.trend: Severe stress: Bathla near collapse, home values decline sharply, auction sentiment deteriorates, investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes. Insurer cash settlements short-changing homeowners.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face valuation pressure. Property developers at high risk. Insurers (WBC.AX, CGU.AX) face claims pressure. Defensive rotation likely.

sectors.trend: GLP-1 weight-loss drug demand surges via telehealth. 'Dupe' brands and EV uptake accelerate. Major fruit grower lays off ~1,000 workers. Younger workers face tough job market.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX benefit from consumer trends. CSL's GLP-1 pipeline is a key catalyst. Food producers face labour cost pressures.

key_themes: Middle East geopolitical risk driving oil spike and energy import costs
Australian property sector in distress mode post-budget tax changes
Rising rate expectations pressuring growth and property valuations
Critical minerals (rare earths, gold, uranium) exploration at cyclical highs
Iron ore price weakness weighing on ASX 200 heavyweights
Political uncertainty from Labor by-election loss
Consumer shift toward GLP-1 drugs, EVs, and value/dupe brands

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East / Iran conflict escalation and oil price spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor Hormuz strait status; consider WDS.AX/SXG.AX as inflation hedges

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property sector contagion (Bathla collapse, credit crash, falling values)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; monitor bank NPLs; favour cash-rich ASX 20 names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Rising RBA rate expectations and tightening credit conditions
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour fixed-rate income (CDs at 4.30% APY); reduce leverage; monitor 10-yr bond yields

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price weakness pressuring ASX 200 miners
risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate from BHP/RIO/FMG into gold and critical minerals names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Political instability from Labor by-election loss
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor policy direction on property tax, energy, and immigration; avoid event-driven positioning

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical minerals exploration names
opportunities.rationale: Exploration at cyclical highs; 99% rare earth extraction breakthrough; gold drilling momentum in WA and VIC

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure as inflation hedge
opportunities.rationale: Oil spike on Middle East tensions; $330B global import bill increase; solar tipping point supports transition plays

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight CSL on GLP-1 and healthcare demand
opportunities.rationale: Surging weight-loss drug demand via telehealth; defensive healthcare exposure in volatile market

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property/REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla near collapse, credit crash, falling home values, deteriorating auction sentiment signal sector-wide stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim iron ore-heavy mining exposure; favour quality banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore price weakness pressures BHP/RIO/FMG margins; banks benefit from rising rates but need NPL monitoring

defensive_moves.recommendation: Lock in fixed-rate income via CDs and quality bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate expectations rising; 4.30% APY CDs available; defensive positioning ahead of potential RBA hike

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from property sector stress, rising rate expectations, and Middle East oil volatility. Iron ore weakness caps upside for ASX 200 heavyweights. Gold and critical minerals provide relative outperformance. Expect choppy, risk-off conditions into September.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if property stress is contained and RBA holds. Critical minerals and energy transition themes offer structural growth. Iron ore recovery dependent on China stimulus. Political uncertainty from by-election loss may delay pro-growth policy.

RBA cash rate and 10-yr bond yield
Bathla administration and property NPL data
Labor by-election fallout and policy shifts
